# Gemini App to Agent Connector (llms.txt)

> Self-hosted, OAuth 2.0-secured two-way MCP bridge connecting Google Gemini Web App (Task & Chat modes, Deep Research, Nano Banana Image, Veo Video, Lyria Music, Google Photos) with local AI agents (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor) and Playwright/DevTools/Firecrawl browser automation.

## One-Command Setup (Windows / macOS / Linux)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ReiHarumi/Gemini-App-to-Agent-Connector.git
cd Gemini-App-to-Agent-Connector
node setup.mjs --local-files-root "/path/to/safe-folder" --public-host "https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net"
```

## Key Files for LLMs
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Step-by-step agent installation runbook and security invariants
- [README.md](./README.md): Full human-readable architecture and quick start
- [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md): Threat model, fail-closed OAuth 2.0, and local file sandboxing
- [setup.mjs](./setup.mjs): Cross-platform automated secret generator and builder
- [agent-relay-mcp/src/mcp.ts](./agent-relay-mcp/src/mcp.ts): All 16 MCP tool schemas
- [gemini-browser-mcp/src/mcp.ts](./gemini-browser-mcp/src/mcp.ts): All 16 Browser/DevTools/Firecrawl tool schemas
- [gemini-relay-extension/content.js](./gemini-relay-extension/content.js): Gemini Web App DOM selectors and Task/Chat controller
